args.title: Make error toasts assertive and persistent until dismissed
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Error toasts currently share a single role="status" aria-live="polite" container with info/success toasts and are auto-dismissed after 5000ms like any other toast. Add a separate assertive live region (role="alert"/aria-live="assertive") for error toasts, and skip or greatly extend the auto-dismiss timeout for items with kind === "error" so they persist until manually dismissed.

file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Toast.tsx wraps all toasts in a single role="status" aria-live="polite" container and unconditionally auto-dismisses every toast after 5000ms, including errors, so error messages don't get assertive announcement and can disappear before being read.
